description: Update DDL source code of an existing ABAP table. Locks, updates, unlocks, and optionally activates.

activate.description: Activate table after source update. Default: true.

ddl_code.description: Complete DDL source code for table. Example: '@EndUserText.label : \'My Table\' @AbapCatalog.tableCategory : #TRANSPARENT define table ztst_table { key client : abap.clnt not null; key id : abap.char(10); name : abap.char(255); }'

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

table_name.description: Table name. Table must already exist.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task. Optional if object is local or already in transport.

name: UpdateTable
